# Software engineering

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

The design, construction, testing, and operation of software. It turns product and interface decisions into a system that keeps working as it changes.

## References

- A change is ready for review. Use the skill `review-code-change`.
- You make or change a decision about the structure of a system. Use the skill `write-decision-record`.
- You review a change or prepare a change for review. Read [Code review](code-review.md).
- You design the structure of a system or change it. Read [Architecture](software-architecture.md).
- You make a commit, a branch, or a release. Read [Delivery](software-delivery.md).
- You define, monitor, or alert on the reliability of a service. Read [Reliability](software-reliability.md).
- You write code that handles input, a user account, or a secret. Read [Security](software-security.md).
- You write a test or fix a bug. Read [Testing](software-testing.md).
